custom_fields.label: This is a site, not a fence
custom_fields.description: A fence refuses somebody outside it. A site records how far out they were and lets them through, which is what field work needs — a system that locks a plumber out at a customer's door is a system they stop using.

custom_fields.label: Also clock in from
custom_fields.description: A depot plus every live site, in one record rather than four overlapping shift assignments.
